name: regionfetch-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the Region Fetch SDK and MCP server.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace regionfetch && npm run build --workspace regionfetch-mcp
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace regionfetch && npm run test --workspace regionfetch-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace regionfetch && npm run typecheck --workspace regionfetch-mcp && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json
